Paper sheet length and residence time The second section of the new approach for evaluating the impact of integrating RF and US technologies on the performance of the dryer section within the paper machine was conducted. The first part of this analysis was revised and completed for the liner board case study, as in Figure 35, and another case study for the corrugated (fluting) medium, as in Figure 36, was added to this section to demonstrate the ability to apply the developed approach on the multi-cylinder machine for various paper grades. The first part of the analysis is critical to estimate any change in the paper machine due to the impact of reducing energy intensity and increasing the drying rate of using RF and US and how that will impact the production rate and other operation and economic parameters.
